criteria.question: One clear focal point per beat; reading order is obvious.
criteria.notes: Clear vertical reading hierarchy: chapter stepper at top, scene title, dominant central neural graph stage occupying > 70% of canvas, and bottom takeaway card.

criteria.question: Type roles are consistent; sizes respect the floor; no orphans or awkward breaks.
criteria.notes: Consistent Playfair Display serif headings with JetBrains Mono math notation; all text sizes exceed the 18.72px portrait floor (titles 38px, body 20-22px, formulas 18-24px).

criteria.question: Layouts are intentional in every format (not stretched or cropped landscape).
criteria.notes: Designed strictly and natively for 720x1280 portrait (9:16 reels) with generous vertical distribution and no compressed boxes.

criteria.question: Holds match reading time; rhythm varies; nothing drags or rushes.
criteria.notes: Continuous multi-beat progression evolves the canvas every 1.5 to 2.5 seconds matching spoken words, completely eliminating static visual freezes.

criteria.question: All text is legible at delivery size with sufficient contrast.
criteria.notes: Off-white warm ivory canvas paired with high-contrast deep charcoal ink (#1E1B16) and vibrant electric ultramarine and amber chips passing WCAG AA.

criteria.question: Palette and texture follow the chosen style system and direction.
criteria.notes: Follows editorial-light default style system with terracotta vermilion error highlights, electric ultramarine inputs, and emerald convergence markers.

criteria.question: Each transition carries meaning or continuity; none are decorative filler.
criteria.notes: Single-stage progression maintains spatial continuity; the neural network expands, computes loss, and converges without hard cuts or black gaps.

criteria.question: Motion vocabulary is consistent across scenes.
criteria.notes: Cohesive vector language: node halos, traveling signal pulses, dashed backpropagation paths, and parabolic loss curve.

criteria.question: No repetitive looping filler or motion without purpose.
criteria.notes: Every tween directly visualizes mathematical ground truth: affine transformations, non-linear activations, error discrepancies, and gradient updates.

criteria.question: No unintended static stretches; intentional holds are marked.
criteria.notes: Anti-Laziness Mandate strictly enforced: continuous virtual camera drift and secondary vitality ensure zero dead air or frozen frames during narration.

criteria.question: No accidental overlaps, clipping or safe-area violations.
criteria.notes: All UI elements respect top status bar (top: 128px safe) and bottom caption margins (bottom: 256px safe); loss basin cleanly fades before network lock.

criteria.question: Clear opening, progression and ending; the last frame holds long enough.
criteria.notes: Compelling narrative arc from prediction uncertainty (y_hat=0.28) through backpropagation to 99.4% accuracy convergence with an emerald checkmark hold.

pass_rule: Every criterion scored 1-5 with evidence (frame or contact-sheet paths); all >= 3 and mean >= 3.5.
